text:
incident-bot: [PAGER] gpu-provisioning critical — queue growth detected (>10k). autoscaler failing to add nodes; paging on-call

alex (oncall): ack, I'm on it.

alex (oncall): quick summary from initial check: cluster-autoscaler tried scale-up but got attach errors and rejected LT mismatches. grabbing logs now.

jamie (sre): saw the same in logs earlier, looks like repeated attach failures + taint mismatch preventing pods from scheduling.

alex (oncall): posting relevant snippet:
```
E 03-19 02:12:45 scale_up.go:214 attach(): AttachInstanceProfile failed: AccessDenied: iam:PassRole
	status code: 403, request id: 1234-abcd
```

maya (infra): checking AWS console. the nodegroup's instance profile role (redwood-gpu-node) doesn't have iam:PassRole for autoscaling service. also the launch template id on nodegroup config != current LT used by bootstrap scripts — autoscaler refuses to attach.

ron (runtime): runtime seeing queue backpressure; KV cache spilling, many inflight requests timing out. recommend short-term traffic shaping / fallback to smaller model to reduce token burn.

li (support): support stack: lots of 429s and long tail latencies from EU customers. ticket spike coming in. marking impact: host-api degraded, dedicated customers on eu-west impacted.

alex (oncall): mitigation options: 1) fix IAM PassRole on role (perm) 2) create emergency nodegroup with correct LT+profile (fast) 3) manually add nodes then reconcile autoscaler. going to try #2 now with infra.

maya (infra): creating nodegroup `emergency-gpu-1793` with LT `lt-0a1b2c3d` and attaching role with PassRole allowed for autoscaling. ETA ~6m.

deploy-bot: create-nodegroup job started: ng-create-1793 (workflow id wf-579).

jamie (sre): while that lands, i'll add temporary annotation to cluster-autoscaler to ignore LT mismatch for short window and allow scale beyond recent limits: `cluster-autoscaler.kubernetes.io/ignore-launch-template-drift: "true"` (will revert after).

alex (oncall): maya — any chance nodes will register as GPU-capable and be schedulable (no extra taints)?

maya (infra): creating with expected taints: `nvidia.com/gpu=true:NoSchedule` — leaving taints consistent with other GPU pools. bootstrapping now.

deploy-bot: nodegroup ng-emergency-1793 created, instances launching (i-0f9e8d7c).

alex (oncall): nodes starting to register to k8s.

jamie (sre): kube events show kubelet registration then `taint effect` checks. pods still pending? checking pod logs.

alex (oncall): scheduling backfill started. backlog numbers: queued requests 20,400 -> 11,200 after first 3 nodes join.

li (support): customers reporting partial recovery. some requests still 503/timeout but trend improving. adding impact notes to incident tracker.

ron (runtime): enabling temporary fallback routing for hosted API to `gpt-small` variants for non-enterprise keys to cut token rate. pushing change now.

maya (infra): nodes Ready. kube-scheduler placing pods. backfill throughput increased.

alex (oncall): queue down to ~3,200 in 8 minutes. good progress.

li (support): support sees latency back to acceptable for most customers; elevated error rate only for a small subset of Dedicated jobs.

jamie (sre): next steps: keep emergency nodes for 2 hours, patch IAM PassRole on `redwood-gpu-node` role (perm fix), reconcile launch template ids across ASGs/nodegroups, and run a canary scale after.

kate (product): understood. please confirm SLA exposure window and list impacted customers for outreach.

li (support): preparing customer-impact spreadsheet, will DM enterprise leads. preliminary window: 02:08–02:46 UTC (partial recovery at 02:20).

maya (infra): applying IAM policy patch now to add `iam:PassRole` for autoscaling principal. will report when applied.

alex (oncall): prepping handoff notes for night shift. summary: root cause appears to be launch-template drift + missing PassRole on instance profile -> autoscaler attach failures -> inability to add GPU nodes -> queue growth. emergency nodegroup created as workaround; traffic fallback reduced pressure.

maya (infra): IAM patch done. verifying autoscaler can now create nodegroups normally.

jamie (sre): testing autoscaler scale-up with synthetic load — scale-up now succeeds in test cluster. will schedule PR to add LT reconciliation check in CI.

alex (oncall): handing off to @sophia (night oncall). notes in incident tracker: emergency ng `emergency-gpu-1793` created, keep for 2h, then drain and terminate once steady. perm fix: IAM policy + LT reconciliation. follow-up: postmortem and checklist update.

sophia (oncall2): ack taking over. monitoring queue and cust impact. reach out if anything regresses.

incident-bot: [INCIDENT] severity downgraded to SEV2 by alex (oncall). incident log INC-1793123456 created.

alex (oncall): closing pager for now — continuing async remediation and postmortem. thanks everyone :heart:
